source: User-provided Organic Minimalism guidelines; no design-agent override
name: Ritim
philosophy: Organic Minimalism, Dieter Rams meets digital zen. No mascots, calories, aggressive colors or gamification.
typography: System sans-serif (SF Pro on iOS), 32pt page titles, 22pt section headings, 16pt body, 12pt uppercase tracked labels
layout: Warm ivory canvas, deep forest text, mint hero, peach nutrition, lavender recovery. 24pt side padding, 24-32pt rounded cards, pill CTAs, sticky safe-area headers, four bottom tabs with central camera action. Horizontal 36pt chips in 56pt sticky rows.
dashboard: Bento dashboard, fluid circular daily score with gentle glow, horizontally scrolling nutrition/sleep/habit cards, warm food photography, prominent photo CTA and honest empty state.
